title: Going from Place to Place
editorial: Fly between Medellin and Cartagena if your trip is only a week.
Guatape works well as a road day-trip from Medellin. Bogota can be added as an entry, exit or connection rather than forced into an already packed route.
Ride-hailing worked for us, though drivers sometimes preferred passengers to sit in front because of tensions with traditional taxi operators at the time.
